put.description:
Patches inspection fields on a single deal item — serials, notes, condition, per-unit quotes and quote prices. Only the keys present in the body are written.

**Notes:** Unlike PUT on the collection route, this does NOT recalculate the deal's finalQuoteAmount. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_DEAL).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/items/[itemId]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

post.summary: Import deal items from a CSV
post.description:
Parses an uploaded CSV of devices, REPLACES all existing items on the deal with the parsed rows, moves the deal to DataReceived and logs the import — all inside one transaction.

**Notes:** DESTRUCTIVE: deletes every existing B2BDealItem on the deal before inserting the CSV rows, and forces deal.status to DataReceived. Naive comma splitting — quoted fields containing commas will be dropped as malformed rows. multipart/form-data. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_DEAL).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/upload/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.description:
Returns all B2B leads ordered by updatedAt desc, each with its most recent interaction. Supports status, free-text search and follow-up-date filtering.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Not paginated - returns every matching lead.

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/leads/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Lead status filter. The literal value 'All' is ignored.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across companyName, contactName, contactEmail, contactPhone and city.

parameters.name: followUp
parameters.description: Follow-up window: today | week | overdue | all. Any value except 'all' also excludes Converted/Lost/Disqualified leads.

post.description:
Creates a B2BLead with an initial 'Lead Created' interaction and assigns it to the logged-in admin (by session email) when a session exists. Emails the B2B notify list.

**Notes:** The session check is COMMENTED OUT - no auth is enforced. Side effect: sends a notification email to the B2B notify list. No server-side validation of required fields. Audited via withAuditLog as B2B_LEAD.

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/leads/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

post.summary: Import B2B buyback leads from CSV
post.description:
Uploads a CSV file (header row: Company, Name, Email, Phone, City, Source) and creates one B2BLead per valid row, each with an initial 'Imported via CSV' interaction note. Sends a single summary email to the B2B notify list.

**Notes:** Session is read for the assignedTo/performedBy name but the auth check is COMMENTED OUT - the route is not gated by the handler itself. Side effect: sends a summary email to user@cashkr.com and user@cashkr.com. Rows are created sequentially (slow for large CSVs). Audited via withAuditLog as B2B_LEAD/IMPORT.

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/leads/import/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

patch.summary: Update a lead or add an interaction
patch.description:
With action='add_interaction' it appends a B2BLeadInteraction attributed to the signed-in admin; otherwise every remaining body key is applied directly as the lead's Prisma update payload.

**Notes:** No field whitelist — the spread of the body goes straight into prisma.b2BLead.update, so any unrecognised key returns a 500. Logs the full request body to the server console. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_LEAD).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/leads/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `other: reads getServerSession only to name the interaction's performedBy (falls back to 'Admin'); requests are never rejected`_

500.description: Update failed (includes unknown keys or an unknown id)

delete.description:
Hard-deletes the B2BLead row.

**Notes:** DESTRUCTIVE hard delete with no auth. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_LEAD).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/leads/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

500.description: Delete failed (includes an unknown id or FK constraint)

post.summary: Convert a B2B lead into a client
post.description:
Uploads the KYC documents to Linode, creates a B2BClient from the lead (with any supplied overrides), then marks the lead Converted and links it to the new client with a Conversion interaction.

**Notes:** multipart/form-data — do not set Content-Type manually. Document upload failures are caught and logged, so conversion still succeeds with a null document URL. Not transactional: the client is created before the lead is flipped to Converted. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_LEAD, action STATUS_CHANGE).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/leads/[id]/convert/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.summary: Get B2B buyback deal and inventory report
get.description:
Aggregates B2B deals for a period into totals by status, closed-deal payment value, pending quote value, active client count, B2B excess-buyback inventory stats and the top 5 clients by deal value.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Read-only aggregation over B2BDeal and ExcessBuyback (source=B2B).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/reports/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

Public website intake form. Validates the payload with Zod and creates a B2BLead (source 'Website', status 'New') with an initial Inquiry interaction, mapping name to company name and district to city.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check - this is the public website form endpoint. Writes a B2BLead, NOT a CorporateBuyback row. Side effect: emails user@cashkr.com and user@cashkr.com. `status` is required by the schema but ignored. Audited via withAuditLog as CORPORATE_BUYBACK.

_Source: `app/api/corporate-buyback/route.ts`_

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

serial.description: Serial number, or a JSON-encoded array of serials (one per unit).

maxQuote.description: Maximum quote allowed for this line.

action.description: Set to 'add_interaction' to log an interaction instead of updating the lead.

type.description: Interaction type when action='add_interaction', e.g. Call.

status.description: Lead status for a regular update, e.g. New | Contacted | Qualified | Converted.

notes.description: Printed on the PDF and stored as poNotes. The whole body is optional.

designation.description: Contact designation; falls back to the lead's jobTitle.

district.description: District - stored as the lead's city

status.description: Required by the schema: PENDING | IN_PROGRESS | APPROVED | REJECTED | COMPLETED. Ignored on write - the lead is always created as 'New'.

id.description: Accepted by the schema for updates but unused

file.description: CSV with a header row. Required columns: 'device type', 'brand', 'model', 'quantity'. Optional: specification/spec/variant, condition, 'is working', 'known issues'.
PDF or image (application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp), max 10 MB.

invoiceNumber.description: Seller invoice number, saved as sellerInvoiceNumber.

invoiceDate.description: Invoice date, parsed with new Date(); ignored when unparseable.

file.description: CSV file. Row order: Company, Name, Email, Phone, City, Source. Header row is skipped.

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

InternalServerError.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure inside the route handler. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
